fact: Prime Minister Moustafa Madbouly appointed a new board for the Information and Decision Support Centre (IDSC), described as a think tank affiliated with the Cabinet, to guide its research agenda with an emphasis on digital transformation and AI-driven policy analysis.
A2K4D at the American University in Cairo, through its MENA Observatory on Responsible AI, held a multistakeholder roundtable on responsible AI in Egypt on 4 May 2025.

The AUC Onsi Sawiris School of Business reports that its A2K4D centre held a workshop at the American University in Cairo on 4 February 2024 sharing a year of its research on data and AI governance, and launched a MENA AI Observatory.
